nodes.description: Owned.owner: privileged address set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor and enforced by the onlyOwner modifier.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner used by the two-step transferOwnership/acceptOwnership handshake.
Arye.balances: mapping(address=>uint) holding token balances, mutated by transfer, transferFrom and the constructor.
Arye.allowed: nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) holding ERC20 allowances, mutated by approve and approveAndCall.
Arye._totalSupply: total token supply, fixed in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Arye.symbol: token symbol, set to 'aex' in the constructor.
Arye.name: token name, set to 'Arye' in the constructor.
Arye.decimals: token decimals, set to 18 in the constructor.
Owned constructor: assigns msg.sender to owner, establishing access control.
transferOwnership(address): onlyOwner function that stages newOwner for the two-step ownership transfer.
acceptOwnership(): completes ownership transfer if msg.sender equals newOwner, then resets newOwner.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint,uint): checked addition with require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint,uint): checked subtraction with require(b <= a).
SafeMath.safeMul(uint,uint): checked multiplication with require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint,uint): checked division with require(b > 0).
Arye constructor: initializes symbol/name/decimals/_totalSupply and mints the whole supply to a fixed address.
totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address): returns the balance mapping entry for the given owner.
transfer(address,uint): debits msg.sender via safeSub and credits the recipient via safeAdd.
approve(address,uint): writes the allowance for msg.sender/spender without checking the previous value.
transferFrom(address,address,uint): moves tokens using the allowance keyed by from/msg.sender and updates both balances.
allowance(address,address): read-only accessor for the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall(address,uint,bytes): sets the allowance and then invokes receiveApproval on the spender contract.
Anonymous payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, refusing plain ETH.
transferAnyERC20Token(address,uint): onlyOwner rescue function that calls transfer on an arbitrary token contract.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, balance and allowance keys throughout the contract.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) made after state updates in approveAndCall.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an owner-supplied arbitrary contract.
Addition operation c = a + b guarded by require(c >= a) in safeAdd.
Subtraction operation c = a - b guarded by require(b <= a) in safeSub.
Multiplication operation c = a * b guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b) in safeMul.
Division operation c = a / b guarded by require(b > 0) in safeDiv.

Second uint parameter b of safeAdd.

edges.reason: Owned constructor writes the untrusted caller address into the privileged owner state variable.
msg.sender becomes the owner, so the caller controls the privileged role.
transferOwnership stores the proposed new owner in newOwner.
Parameter _newOwner is supplied to transferOwnership.
The onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner to gate transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner to the privileged owner slot.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner, so the caller controls the ownership handshake.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0) after the handshake.
Parameter a is an operand of the addition in safeAdd.
Parameter b is an operand of the addition in safeAdd.
The addition result is assigned to local c in safeAdd.
safeAdd executes the guarded addition operation.
Parameter a is an operand of the subtraction in safeSub.
Parameter b is an operand of the subtraction in safeSub.
The subtraction result is assigned to local c in safeSub.
safeSub executes the guarded subtraction operation.
Parameter a is an operand of the multiplication in safeMul.
Parameter b is an operand of the multiplication in safeMul.
The multiplication result is assigned to local c in safeMul.
safeMul executes the guarded multiplication operation.
Parameter a is an operand of the division in safeDiv.
Parameter b is an operand of the division in safeDiv.
The division result is assigned to local c in safeDiv.
safeDiv executes the guarded division operation.
Arye constructor sets the symbol state variable.
Arye constructor sets the name state variable.
Arye constructor sets the decimals state variable.
Arye constructor fixes the total supply.
Arye constructor mints the entire supply into the balances mapping of a hard-coded address.
totalSupply() reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply() reads balances[address(0)] to subtract burned tokens.
balanceOf takes tokenOwner as the mapping key.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the requested owner.
transfer receives the destination address parameter.
transfer receives the token amount parameter.
transfer uses msg.sender as the source account key of the balance mapping.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transfer writes updated balances for sender and recipient.
msg.sender keys the balance slot that transfer debits.
approve receives the spender address parameter.
approve receives the allowance amount parameter.
approve uses msg.sender as the owner key of the allowance mapping.
approve overwrites allowed[msg.sender][spender] without reading the prior allowance.
transferFrom receives the from address parameter.
transferFrom receives the to address parameter.
transferFrom receives the token amount parameter.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender key of the nested allowance mapping.
transferFrom calls safeSub for the source balance and the allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the destination balance.
transferFrom writes the updated balances mapping entries.
transferFrom decrements the allowance in the allowed mapping.
allowance receives the tokenOwner key parameter.
allowance receives the spender key parameter.
allowance reads the nested allowed mapping.
approveAndCall receives the spender address, which is also the external call target.
approveAndCall receives the token amount parameter.
approveAndCall receives the bytes payload forwarded to the callee.
approveAndCall uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key and forwards it to the callee.
approveAndCall writes the allowance before performing the external call.
approveAndCall performs an external call to the caller-supplied spender contract.
msg.sender and the controllable spender address reach the external receiveApproval call.
The invoked receiver can call back into the token contract while approveAndCall is still executing.
transferAnyERC20Token receives the arbitrary token contract address parameter.
transferAnyERC20Token receives the amount parameter.
transferAnyERC20Token reads the owner variable as the recipient of the rescue transfer.
transferAnyERC20Token makes an external call transferring tokens out of an arbitrary contract.
The onlyOwner modifier verifies msg.sender equals owner before the rescue transfer.
The payable fallback is reachable by any external caller but unconditionally reverts.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter a of safeAdd carries no identity beyond the call and should be absorbed into fn_safeAdd.
Parameter b of safeAdd carries no identity beyond the call and should be absorbed into fn_safeAdd.
Parameter a of safeSub is only meaningful inside fn_safeSub and should be merged into it.
Parameter b of safeSub is only meaningful inside fn_safeSub and should be merged into it.
Parameter a of safeMul is only meaningful inside fn_safeMul and should be merged into it.
Parameter b of safeMul is only meaningful inside fn_safeMul and should be merged into it.
Parameter a of safeDiv is only meaningful inside fn_safeDiv and should be merged into it.
Parameter b of safeDiv is only meaningful inside fn_safeDiv and should be merged into it.
_newOwner is the sole argument of transferOwnership and can be folded into that function node.
tokenOwner is the sole read key of balanceOf and can be folded into that function node.
Parameter to is only used inside transfer and should be merged into fn_transfer.
Parameter tokens is only used inside transfer and should be merged into fn_transfer.
Parameter spender is only used inside approve and should be merged into fn_approve.
Parameter tokens is only used inside approve and should be merged into fn_approve.
Parameter from is only used inside transferFrom and should be merged into fn_transferFrom.
Parameter to is only used inside transferFrom and should be merged into fn_transferFrom.
Parameter tokens is only used inside transferFrom and should be merged into fn_transferFrom.
Parameter tokenOwner is only used inside allowance and should be merged into fn_allowance.
Parameter spender is only used inside allowance and should be merged into fn_allowance.
spender directly determines the target of the external receiveApproval call and should be merged into that unsafe operation.
Parameter tokens is only used inside approveAndCall and should be merged into fn_approveAndCall.
The data payload is forwarded verbatim to the external receiveApproval call and belongs to that unsafe operation.
tokenAddress directly selects the external contract called by transferAnyERC20Token and should be merged into that unsafe operation.
Parameter tokens is only used inside transferAnyERC20Token and should be merged into that function.
Local c is purely the result of the guarded addition and should be folded into uo_add_safeAdd.
Local c is purely the result of the guarded subtraction and should be folded into uo_sub_safeSub.
Local c is purely the result of the guarded multiplication and should be folded into uo_mul_safeMul.
Local c is purely the result of the guarded division and should be folded into uo_div_safeDiv.
